analysis.title: Nomura Cross-Asset: JENSEN & AI TBTF, AS (+) EQUITIES WEALTH EFFECT = U.S. NATSEC
key_insights: McElligott argues AI and equities are treated as too big to fail and matters of national security, with authorities forced to respond asymmetrically dovish to protect a positive wealth effect.
A government intervention in NVDA and the reinstatement of Huang drove a repricing of the left tail lower, after significant risk premium had been added to worst-case scenarios in recent weeks.

Front VIX fell about 5 vols on the news. Dealer and market maker short futures hedges against now deep OTM puts are being bought back as the puts lose delta, which feeds mechanical equity buying via vanna.
SPX broke through the daily straddle upside band. Dealers are shifting back toward a long gamma versus spot location as vol selling, hedge unwind and upside chasing continue.
Phase 2 is CTA trend. The Nomura QIS CTA model says the S&P 12-month signal flips back Long from Short if SPX closes above 7043, implying about +$16B to buy in SPX and +$2.5B in NDX.
The 12-month window carries 46% of loading across the five time-series windows. Other tenors remain Short for now, and Nasdaq shows about +$2.4B of buy-to-cover above 26k.
A hypothetical +4% shock implies nearly +$34B of global equity futures to buy.
A 4.0 to 5.0% one-day SPX gain implies a target vol and vol control sell of about $11B to $16B today.
Leveraged ETF end-of-day rebalancing is tracking +$41.0B to buy, the second largest on record in Nomura's series behind 4/9/26 at +$46.5B, and dwarfs the vol control selling.

The one-day bounce does not resolve structural concerns: tighter financial conditions, an AI capex reset hitting growth, still-high inflation with a hawkish policy inflection, higher real rates, wider credit spreads and a negative wealth effect from the equity drawdown.

A risk is a longer-horizon rotation out of equities into cash and bonds, away from the decade-plus buy-the-dip, sell-the-vol-rip conditioning. Whether investors return to FOMO or stay in JOMO depends on spot-vol correlation and VIX beta.
If NVDA stays the central bank of AI and keeps financing obligations, the NGDP tailwind from the data center build persists, which extends the virtuous cycle and cuts delta on the left tail.

market_movers.rationale: Government intervention and Huang's reinstatement triggered a vol crush and mechanical equity rally. NVDA's role as central bank of AI is seen as supporting the data center build.

sector_views.rationale: The intervention cuts left-tail risk, but structural tightening in financial conditions and the AI capex reset remain unresolved.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Pre-open and intraday rally magnitude that drives vol control selling and leveraged ETF buying.

risk_factors: The one-day mechanical bounce may fade without resolving tightening financial conditions.
The AI capex reset could hurt growth.
Inflation remains too high, which implies hawkish policy.
Higher real rates and wider credit spreads continue to weigh.
A negative wealth effect from the equity drawdown could hit household sentiment and consumption.
Asset allocation could shift out of equities into cash and bonds.
The flow estimates depend on intraday implementation and spot-vol correlation assumptions.
vol_and_positioning: Front VIX is down about 5 vols after the NVDA intervention news.
Vol crush is mean-reverting off prior extremes in realized vol, vol of vol and skew, creating vanna-driven dealer futures covering.
Dealers are shifting to long gamma versus spot after the rally through the straddle upside band.
CTA trend signals had flipped Short across all windows in SP500, and the 12-month window may flip Long on an SPX close above 7043.
Vol control selling is estimated at $11B to $16B, versus leveraged ETF rebalance buying of +$41.0B.
Investors are described as in bunkers and focused on preservation of capital, with the risk of JOMO persisting.
geopolitical: The US government intervened in NVDA and reinstated Huang, framed as a national security matter.
